ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels restricted to the peripheral trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white contiguous field across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous, irregular band along the trailing edge, expanding into thick terminal blocks at both lateral tips. Micro-scale dark mottling is concentrated in the peri-notch region and scattered sparsely across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with an estimated aperture of 65-75 degrees and significant pixel-depth relative to the adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and frequent serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary. Serration amplitude is most pronounced on the inner two-thirds of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a smooth convex trajectory from the center, transitioning into a sharper upward curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several dark, circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites) are localized vertically below the median notch and on the lower interior portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the upper-mid section of the right lobe, oriented diagonally; a single faint horizontal line is visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark pitting and linear scarring across the ventral surface; significant irregular black pigmentation on the trailing edges representing potential healed tissue or natural patterning.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced thickness of black pigmentation at the fluke tips compared to the relatively thin trailing edge border.
